GOOD TO KNOW

Have
questions?

Contact the developer ↗
Does it block all of YouTube or Instagram?

un:short detects and blocks supported Shorts and Reels screens. Home-feed blocking is a separate Beta setting. Detection can vary with the target app version and screen layout, so check that it works after installing.

Do I have to flip my phone?

The timer runs while your phone is face down and pauses when you pick it up. The default wait is 30 seconds and can be adjusted. You can choose to stop watching, or use Watch now depending on your settings and usage limits.

Is it free to use?

You can start for free. The app contains ads and in-app purchases. Free use includes a daily limit on instant viewing. Check the in-app purchase screen for current premium benefits and prices.

Why is accessibility permission needed?

It detects Shorts, Reels, home-feed screens and scrolling in the apps you select, and controls the blocking flow. You can revoke the permission at any time in Android settings.

Where is my usage data stored?

Viewing statistics and tasks are stored on your device. Ads, payments, analytics, error diagnostics, and fetching feature settings may involve network communication. See the privacy policy linked from the Google Play listing for details.

Can I use it on iPhone?

The un:short app shown here is for Android. It supports Android 8.0 and later. Behavior can vary by device and target app version.
